title: The 2 Best Travel Adapters for Laptops
h1: The 2 Best Travel Adapters for Laptops
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for travel adapters for laptops, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel adapters for laptops using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: OREI World Travel Plug Adapter M8 Max
products.blurb: Key specs: Grounded 3-prong AC outlets, 3 USB-A ports plus 1 USB-C PD 18W port, Interchangeable plug attachments for 150+ countries.
strengths: Grounded outlets accept a standard laptop brick safely
Extra USB ports charge a mouse, phone, and headphones alongside the laptop
Compact enough to keep in a laptop bag pocket
limitations: 18W USB-C port is not fast enough to charge most laptops directly
Only 2 AC outlets total, so two laptop bricks at once is tight
features: 3 USB-A ports plus 1 USB-C PD 18W port

products.name: BESTEK Universal Travel Adapter
products.blurb: Key specs: 3 AC sockets rated up to 250W combined, 100-220V to 110V step-down conversion, 6A 4-port USB charging.
strengths: 250W ceiling comfortably covers even high-draw laptop chargers (most run 45 to 100W)
Three AC sockets fit a laptop brick plus two other AC-plug devices
Useful if traveling with older single-voltage equipment alongside the laptop
limitations: Bulkiest and heaviest option in this list
Overkill on wattage for most modern dual-voltage laptop chargers
features: 3 AC sockets rated up to 250W combined

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
